themes.theme: Growth and Structure of the Private Rented Sector
themes.reason: Provides background context on the size and growth of the PRS, establishing scale but not itself explaining why fees are high or opaque.
Describes existing transparency rules and their limited enforcement, directly supporting the diagnosis that opacity persists despite regulation - a key part of the 'opaque fees' problem.
This is the central evidentiary theme documenting how high and inconsistent fees are, the core factual basis for the 'high, opaque fees' problem; without it the diagnosis has no substance.

themes.theme: Market Failure and Lack of Competition
themes.reason: Explains the causal mechanism - weak competitive pressure on tenant-facing fees - which is essential to explain why fees are high and opaque rather than just asserting they are.

themes.theme: Impact on Tenants - Financial Harm and Churn
themes.reason: Demonstrates the real-world effects and scale of harm from fees, supporting the case that this is a significant problem needing intervention.
Gives examples of bad behaviour by a minority of agents, adding colour but the diagnosis does not depend on these specific unfair/discriminatory practices to stand.
A single passing reference to Northern Ireland surveys, too minor and tangential to carry any part of the argument.
